study.title: Proverbs 2 Seek wisdom to be guarded from evil
study.overview: This chapter presents wisdom as something that should be sought with effort, humility and inner attention. The father's teaching to the child shows that wisdom is not mere accumulation of information: it comes from God, shapes character and protects the person from destructive paths. The chapter advances in three movements: first, the call to seek wisdom; then, the promise of deliverance of wicked men; finally, protection against immoral woman and the contrast between the righteous who remain and the wicked who are removed from the earth.

outline.title: Seek with all the heart
outline.explanation: The son is exhorted to welcome the words, give attention, cry out and seek wisdom as those who seek a treasure. The result is to know the fear of the Lord and to find the knowledge of God.

outline.title: God gives wisdom that preserves from evil way
outline.explanation: Wisdom is the gift of the LORD; it keeps the upright, teaches justice, and protects from men who forsake the good ways to do evil and violence.

outline.title: Protection against seduction and final destination of paths
outline.explanation: Wisdom also frees from the wicked woman and her flattering words. The chapter concludes with the contrast between the righteous, who will remain on the earth, and the wicked, who will be plucked from it.

study.context: The chapter is presented as paternal instruction addressed to a child, in the typical style of sapiential literature. The notes provided link the permanence on earth to obedience to the commandments of God, in harmony with the biblical theme of the covenant. The text does not depend here on additional external details; he himself points out that wise and faithful life has concrete implications in the experience of God's people.
study.theology: The theology of the chapter unites human responsibility and divine grace. There is a strong imperative: to hear, to incline the heart, to cry out and to seek. But wisdom in its origin is given by the LORD; it is not only born of observation or of human technique. It leads to the fear of the LORD, that is, to an obedient reverence, and produces moral discernment. In addition, wisdom has protective value: preserves from corrupting companies, perverse practices and sexual seduction. The chapter ends with a moral doctrine of retribution: the righteous remain, the wicked are removed. This shows that life before God has direction, consequences and outcome. In Christian language, the text teaches that true wisdom is not neutral, but character forms, governs choices and leads to life.

scholarViews.insight: To seek wisdom requires attention to the Scriptures and recognize that it is the gift of God, not the fruit of human observation.
The chapter shows both how to obtain wisdom and how to use it: it preserves the company and the practices of evil.
Wisdom protects from the deception of the immoral woman, whose flattering words they draw to death.

questions: What concrete ways do I show that I am seeking wisdom as a treasure, and not just admiring it from afar?
What voices, habits, or relationships today try to turn me away from the right path, and how can wisdom preserve me?
Am I treating biblical wisdom as something that needs to govern my daily choices, or just as religious knowledge?
study.practice: Set up time to read the Scriptures with obedient attention, not just informative. Choose a practical area of the week in which you need discernment - words, relationships, purity, financial decisions or time usage - and ask God for specific wisdom for that area. Then, notice if your choices are aligned with the ways of justice. It is also worth identifying an influence that is weakening and setting clear boundaries before it.
study.uncertainty: The notes provided are in English and are interpretations, not the biblical text itself. Some observations of commentators bring historical and moral applications that should be read as interpretive readings, not as absolute certainty required by the chapter. It is also not possible to confirm, from only these notes, additional external details about date, exact scenario or original terms beyond what has already been indicated.
